item.title: Trump-Tillis tiff deepens as president says he ‘quit,’ concedes Fed fight could doom new chair confirmation
item.summary: Kevin Warsh's Federal Reserve confirmation hearing heads to the Senate next week, but Sen. Thom Tillis, R-N.C., plans to block President Donald Trump's pick over DOJ probe.

item.title: Nick Shirley warns California bill could punish people trying to expose government fraud
item.summary: A proposed California bill aims to protect immigration support providers, but critics claim it could shield fraudsters from citizen investigations.

item.title: Maniac who stabbed boy outside Walmart was previously freed after attacking dad, church rampage: report
item.summary: A Nebraska woman fatally shot by police after allegedly cutting a boy at a Walmart had prior felony charges for allegedly stabbing her father in 2024.

item.title: DHS shutdown enters Day 60 with all eyes on House Republicans to end it
item.summary: Congress returned with no end in sight for the 60-day DHS shutdown as Republicans eye a "skinny" reconciliation bill to fund immigration enforcement.

item.title: Sen Kennedy warns Democrat 'loon wing' has 'fried' the party’s motherboard
item.summary: Sen. John Kennedy ripped Democratic leadership, claiming radical progressives have seized control of the party with what he calls "nauseously woke" policies.

item.title: Golf analyst Brandel Chamblee rips LIV Golf as reports fuel speculation about its future: 'Lame-brained tour'
item.summary: LIV Golf reportedly faces shutdown as sources claim players went unpaid and executives held an emergency meeting. Golf analyst Brandel Chamblee backed the reports.

item.title: Heat's Erik Spoelstra calls LaMelo Ball's play 'stupid' after Bam Adebayo injured in play-in loss
item.summary: Heat coach Erik Spoelstra said LaMelo Ball should have been thrown out after yanking Bam Adebayo's foot, causing a lower back injury in a Play-In Tournament loss.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney doubles down with American Eagle after controversial 'Great Jeans' campaign
item.summary: Sydney Sweeney fronts a new American Eagle denim campaign called "Syd for Short," a sun-soaked sequel to her buzzworthy 2025 debut collaboration.

item.title: Missing teen found hiding in convicted sex offender's closet in Florida, sheriff says
item.summary: A convicted sex offender in Florida was arrested after a missing 17-year-old girl was found hiding in his bedroom closet in Dundee, authorities said.

item.title: Millions tap Trump tax cuts this filing season as refunds top $3,400
item.summary: Over 53 million tax filers claimed Trump's signature tax cuts this season, with the average refund climbing above $3,400, Treasury Department data shows.
